gloss: one time only; one-time; once only

definitions.gloss: one time only; one-time; once only
definitions.explanation: Limited to a single occurrence, with no repetition. Used to emphasize that something happens or is available only once.

examples.japanese: このクーポンは{一回限|いっかいかぎ}り{有効|ゆうこう}です。
examples.english: This coupon is valid for one use only.

examples.japanese: {一回限|いっかいかぎ}りのチャンスを{逃|のが}すな。
{無料体験|むりょうたいけん}は{一回限|いっかいかぎ}りとなっておりますので、ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: Please understand that the free trial is limited to one time only.

notes:
Composed of {一回|いっかい} (one time) and {限|かぎ}り (limit, only). Functions as a noun that modifies other nouns with の, or stands alone as a predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一回限|いっかいかぎ}りの{特別|とくべつ}サービス: a one-time-only special service
- {一回限|いっかいかぎ}り{有効|ゆうこう}: valid for one use
- {一回限|いっかいかぎ}りのイベント: a one-time event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一度|いちど}きり: only once — emphasizes the emotional weight of a single occurrence
- {単発|たんぱつ}: one-time, one-shot — used for events, jobs, or projects
- {限定|げんてい}: limited — broader term for limited availability
